ansur.producer: U.S. Army Natick Soldier Research, Development and Engineering Center
ansur.title: 2012 Anthropometric Survey of U.S. Army Personnel: Methods and Summary Statistics
ansur.population: Measured female US Army personnel, 2010-2012; not a representative civilian sample.
ansur.unit_warning: Use measured stature and span, not self-reported Heightin. Excluded weightkg is in hectograms, not kg.
ansur.distribution: Army report approved for public release; university hosts the public working database. Host is a mirror, not the study author.

supporting_references.title: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 2, Appendix E: Physical Characteristics and Capabilities Data Sets
supporting_references.provenance: E.2 uses ANSUR 1988 projected to 2015, distinct from ANSUR II. E.3 distinguishes unsuited and suited motion. E.5 discusses skeletal landmark axes.
supporting_references.limitation: Microgravity allowances and human mass regressions do not transfer automatically to a terrestrial armature. Exact NASA edition used previously in PHY was not recovered.

historical.title: The Ten Books on Architecture, Book III, Chapter I, paragraphs 2-3
historical.edition: Morris Hicky Morgan translation, Harvard University Press, 1914
historical.limitation: These historical fractions are compared, never silently adopted. They are not empirical female measurements.

stature.definition: Standing surface to vertex; erect, head in Frankfurt plane.

span.definition: Middle fingertip to middle fingertip with arms extended horizontally.

acromionradialelength.definition: Right acromion to radiale, measured parallel to relaxed upper arm.

biacromialbreadth.definition: Between acromion landmarks, seated with shoulders relaxed at quiet respiration.

bicristalbreadth.definition: Between iliocristale landmarks with tissue compressed toward the bony landmarks.

chestbreadth.definition: Chest width at anterior chest-point level; tissue compressed, maximum inspiration.

chestdepth.definition: Anterior chest point to back at matching level during quiet respiration.

radialestylionlength.definition: Right radiale to stylion, measured parallel to forearm with palm forward.

handlength.definition: Right wrist stylion to middle fingertip using the report's supported-hand posture.

footlength.definition: Weight-bearing right heel to longest toe, measured along the foot device.

unresolved_targets.head_height_mm: ANSUR headlength is front-to-back, not chin-to-crown height; select a matched endpoint source.
unresolved_targets.humerus_length_mm: Acromion-radiale is a proxy; osteometric endpoints and shoulder/elbow centers require separate definition.
unresolved_targets.radius_length_mm: Radiale-stylion is a proxy; bone ends and cartridge datums require separate definition.
unresolved_targets.ulna_length_mm: Do not copy radius or forearm length into ulna length.
unresolved_targets.femur_length_mm: Standing external heights are not femoral head-to-condyle length.
unresolved_targets.tibia_length_mm: Tibiale height is not isolated tibia length or knee-to-ankle center spacing.
unresolved_targets.fibula_length_mm: Do not derive from tibia length without a selected endpoint model.
unresolved_targets.joint_centers_and_mechanism_paths: Scalar anthropometry cannot determine 3D centers, shoulder trajectories, bearings, stops, or fixture interfaces.
